facts.label: Elogios
facts.sub: Diga I like your jacket. Agradeça Thank you! Pergunte Where did you buy it? How much is it? e Do you know the name of the shop? Agradeça de novo.

facts.label: Faça um elogio
facts.sub: Elogie algo específico, como uma jaqueta, sapatos ou uma cor. Use frases curtas, sorria e fale com um tom simpático e calmo.

facts.label: Agradeça
facts.sub: Quando alguém elogia você, responda Thank you! Não precisa dizer que a roupa é velha ou barata. Um sorriso e um obrigado bastam.

pages.title: A green jacket · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a quiet Saturday afternoon in a big store in Portland. Clothes hang in neat rows under bright lights. Beto looks for a warm jacket for the fall. He sees a woman in a beautiful green jacket. He thinks it is exactly what he wants. He walks up to her and smiles.
“Excuse me. I like your jacket.” says Mara. “Oh, thank you! That is so nice of you.” says Mara. “Where did you buy it? It is a great color.” says Mara.
